paths.name: framer-motion
paths.message: Import { m, MotionProvider } from '@/lib/motion' instead. A bare framer-motion import defeats LazyMotion tree-shaking for the whole bundle (CONVENTIONS.md 6).

no-restricted-syntax.message: box-shadow, drop-shadow and backdrop blur are banned (13A build constraint 1). These utilities were also deleted from the Tailwind theme, so this class emits no CSS. Separate surfaces with a colour change or a 1px rule.
Hardcoded hex colour. There are six colours and they are all tokens (13A build constraint 5). Use bg-/text-/border- with concrete, sheet, ink, rule, hazard or cure.
Exactly two radii exist: rounded-none for factual, rounded-milled for pressable (13A build constraint 2). rounded-full is reserved for the Plate status indicator.
warning and danger are not part of the six colours and are banned on 13B surfaces (13A build constraint 5). They exist only for pre-13B admin and widget error states.

THE MONO RULE (13A build constraint 3): mono appears only on measured values, plate text and the build log. Never on headlines or buttons. Mono used decoratively reads as developer portfolio, and that reads as a hobbyist who will disappear.
No scroll-triggered animation of any kind (13A build constraint 4). A page whose contents arrive as you scroll is a page performing for you.
